objects.description: [TeamPCP Cloud Stealer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9041) can compress and encrypt data and exfiltrate it via POST to an attacker-controlled domain. If that method fails it can use the victim's own GitHub account to create a public repository and uploads the encrypted data as a release asset.(Citation: Wiz Trivy Compromise MAR 2026)(Citation: Aqua Security Trivy Compromise MAR 2026)(Citation: Aqua Security Blog Trivy Compromise APR 2026)(Citation: Wiz TeamPCP KICS MAR 2026)(Citation: Palo Alto TeamPCP MAR 2026)
